- Clicking the left stem at col23: no effect (C stays at col8).

Hmm, wait, actually the left stems might also be toggles, but they're already B (dark), so... no, that's not it: the left stems are w (light), and clicking (36,8) moved C. Clicking (36,13) did nothing.
Hmm, wait a moment. Let me reconsider: maybe the left C's movement wasn't caused by the (36,8) click. The batch was [(36,8), (36,13), (58,11)]. Maybe the C moved because of the tray box click (58,11)! The left tray box (cols 8-14, center ~11) is selected (blue border). Clicking it might "send" the C to... col8? The box's yellow square is at cols 8-9 (left side of the box). So clicking the left box moves C to the position indicated by the yellow square within the box = left → C moves to the leftmost mark's column (col8)!
This makes sense! The tray box is a "positioning control": the yellow square within the box indicates where the piece should go. Clicking the box moves the piece to that position. Left box's yellow is left-center → C goes to left-center (col8, rows 16-19 = panel's vertical center). ✓
Right box's yellow is top-center → clicking the right box moves the U to top-center (cols 45-48, rows ~7-10)!
And the stems are toggles (w↔B) — the right stem at col44 toggled to B. So the marks are still toggles, and the goal is probably: set the marks to the target pattern AND position the pieces, then click the ball.
Wait, but the left stems: clicking (36,8) — did it toggle? The diff for that batch only showed C's movement (no stem color change). Hmm, if the left stems were toggles, (36,8) should have turned w→B. It didn't. So the left stems are not toggles. But the right stems are.
Hmm, actually wait: maybe the left stems are also toggles, but the C's movement and the toggle happened simultaneously... no, the diff didn't show any stem color change at col8.
Let me recheck the current state: are the left stems still w? And is the right stem at col44 now B?
From the last diff: (35,44),(36,44),(37,44) w→B. Yes.
So: the left stems are not toggles; the right stems are toggles. Weird asymmetry. Unless the left stems are already "set" (B = target achieved?) — no, they're w.
Hmm, wait. Let me reconsider. Maybe all stems are toggles, but the left ones were toggled by the first batch's (36,8) and (36,13) clicks... but the diff didn't show any color change. Unless the toggle is w→B→w and two clicks... no, (36,8) was clicked only once.
Let me look at the current left stems' colors in the image: the left group's stems look light gray (w). The right group: col44's stem is now dark (B), the others are w.
OK, so the left stems are not toggles.
New world model:
- Left panel: C piece (movable), 4 stems (not toggles), 4 top bars (B, not toggles? I clicked them earlier and nothing happened).
- Right panel: frame + U pieces (movable?), 4 stems (toggles), 4 top bars (w, toggles?).
- Tray boxes: click to move pieces to the indicated position.
- Ball: confirm.
Hmm, this is getting complicated. Let me test:
1. Click the right box (58,21) → does the U move to top-center?
2. Click the right top bar (33,44) → does it toggle?
3. Click the left box again → does C move (it's already at col8)?
Actually, let me think about what the goal is. Level 1: piece + U + ball; the marks toggled; the solution was all-B marks + ball. Level 1's pieces were... did they move? I don't recall moving them. Level 1's marks: 5 columns × 2 rows, all toggles.
Level 2: the left group's top bars are B (fixed?), stems are w (not toggles); the right group is all w (toggles).
Maybe the left group's marks are "already solved" (showing the target pattern: top B / stem w), and the right group needs to be set to match the right box's pattern? The right box shows yellow at top-center...
Hmm, or the marks represent the "position" of the pieces: the left C is at col8 = the 1st mark; the left mark's top bar is B (dark) = "the piece is here"? The right U is at cols 45-48 ≈ the 2nd/3rd mark (cols 44/49)... the right marks are all w = "the piece is not here"?
And the goal: move the pieces so the marks light up? But the left marks are all B (all 4 top bars), yet C is at only 1 column.
I'm going in circles. Let me just test the right box click to see if the U moves.
